title: Selective Linkage Precision for Released Medical Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.02276v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hospitals may release de-identified chest radiographs while restricting access to their reports. An attacker who already has reports from the same population and their metadata can use a vision-language model (VLM) to match images to reports. We introduce selective linkage precision, which measures correct matches among the highest-confidence queries after filtering candidates by the available attributes. Across 8 public VLMs and 3 chest radiograph datasets, the maximum whole-pool Recall@1 is 0.40%. However, this metric averages over every query without attribute filtering. On ReXGradient-160K, MedSigLIP-448 reaches 67.68% precision at a budget of 100 after filtering by sex, age band, and projection, with a median of 327 candidate reports. translated_title: 面向已发布医学视觉-语言模型的选择性链接精确度
translated_abstract: 医院可能会发布去标识化的胸部X光片，同时限制对其报告的访问。已经拥有同一人群报告及其元数据的攻击者可以利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）将图像与报告进行匹配。我们提出了选择性链接精确度这一指标，用于在通过可用属性过滤候选者之后，衡量最高置信度查询中的正确匹配比例。在8个公开VLM和3个胸部X光片数据集上的实验表明，全池Recall@1的最大值仅为0.40%。然而，该指标是在没有属性过滤的情况下对所有查询求平均的结果。在ReXGradient-160K数据集上，MedSigLIP-448在按性别、年龄段和投照体位过滤后，在预算为100的情况下达到67.68%的精确度，中位候选报告数为327份。在相同的合格查询集上，仅使用属性的策略达到24.99%，而仅使用模型仅达到1.98%。加入采集年份信息（仅在3个数据集中的1个可用）后，精确度可达到99.05%。
tldr: 本文提出“选择性链接精确度”指标，揭示攻击者利用元数据属性过滤结合公开医学视觉-语言模型，能够以极高精确度（最高67.68%，加入采集年份后达99.05%）将去标识化胸部X光片与受限报告重新链接，证明传统全池召回率指标严重低估了医学图像发布的隐私泄露风险。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces selective linkage precision, showing that attackers can combine metadata attribute filtering with public medical vision-language models to re-link de-identified chest radiographs to restricted reports with high precision (up to 67.68%, rising to 99.05% with acquisition year), demonstrating that whole-pool recall metrics severely underestimate privacy risks.
